text: National home prices slip negative for the first time in over two years. High-frequency data shows softening demand, uneven regional movements, and weak builder sentiment. Mortgage-rate stasis limits directional motion, producing a narrow, low-variance band around zero.

meta.note: Exposure vs. collapse boundary thin; compression dominant but ambiguous threshold.

text: FSOC's regulatory posture shifts from tightening to loosening. A new working group forms to assess AI-related systemic resilience. The reversal exposes internal authority direction and reorients the framework toward reduced constraint with concurrent monitoring structures.

meta.note: Inversion vs. alignment layering ambiguous; exposure secondary but active.

text: Disney invests in OpenAI and licenses broad IP for AI video and image generation. Guardrails and rights controls are embedded. Internal deployment and curated output indicate controlled integration rather than open expansion. The move formalizes a structured interface between legacy IP systems and AI.

meta.note: Bridge vs. alignment boundary thin; continuity selected due to legacy-system preservation.

text: Broadcom reports strong earnings with AI-driven revenue acceleration. Custom-chip orders increase, backlog grows, and new customers surface. The field consolidates around high-load AI infrastructure, with continuity reinforced through multiyear chip commitments and stable demand.

meta.note: Exposure vs. alignment weight close; alignment chosen due to systemic coherence across signals.

text: Indiana Senate rejects a federally pressured redistricting effort despite partisan majority alignment. Internal dissent overrides external leverage, halting expected outcome. The vote reveals loss of unified command flow within the authority structure.

meta.note: Authority-split vs. inversion overlap; split prioritized due to internal divergence signal.

text: Lululemon announces CEO departure after prolonged underperformance and weak guidance. Interim leadership installed as search begins. Market response turns positive, indicating release of accumulated strain and preparation for structural reorientation.

meta.note: Purge vs. alignment sequencing uncertain; collapse primary, next-state not yet resolved.
